The workflow also includes steps to obtain information about enabling a specific service in NixOS, such as the SSH service, and to search for options related to a particular shell in the Home Manager options. From the Home Manager search results, one or more options are selected for more detailed information. The workflow concludes by presenting the collected package and configuration information, supporting diagnostic or setup tasks related to NixOS and the referenced packages.
